episode.title: Oxford University Is Older Than The Aztec Empire

synopsis: Oxford University began teaching long before the Aztec Empire was established in Mesoamerica.

title_card.title: Oxford is older than the Aztec Empire.
title_card.subtitle: Teaching began centuries before Tenochtitlan.

caption:
Oxford University is actually older than the Aztec Empire.

Teaching took place at Oxford as early as 1096, expanding rapidly in the twelfth century. Meanwhile, the Aztec Empire was founded with the rise of Tenochtitlan in 1325.

Visuals created with AI.

Did you realize Oxford was that old?
